title: Jazzy Ethiopian Tofu Stew
description: A briny, pillowy stew bursting with midnight cravings, brightened by blue food coloring and a broil finish on a binchotan grill.
instructions: Preheat the binchotan grill to high heat and oil the grill grate lightly.
In a bowl, combine tofu cubes, berbere, salt, pepper, and 2 drops of blue food coloring; toss until tofu is evenly coated.
Place the tofu on the grill grates and broil for 5 minutes, flipping halfway, until edges are slightly crisp.
Meanwhile, heat olive oil in a skillet on the grill and sauté onions until translucent.
Add minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for 1 minute until fragrant.
Stir in tomato paste, continue cooking for 2 minutes, then pour in vegetable broth, bringing mixture to a simmer.
Add the broiled tofu to the skillet, reduce heat, cover, and let stew simmer for 10 minutes to meld flavors.
Finish by squeezing lemon juice over the stew and adjusting salt to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro, and enjoy the midnight craving.
